summary: Tested all new POS features: 5 new sidebar pages (Reservations, Loyalty, Ingredients, Reports, Restaurant Settings), backend merge/split endpoints, and frontend split/merge modals on /payments. Backend: 12/12 pytest tests passed (8 new module GETs + 4 merge/split scenarios including validation). Frontend: all 5 new pages navigate correctly with no console errors. Split modal opens, mode toggle (by_items/equal) works, end-to-end equal split confirmed (order count 18 -> 20, success toast 'Addition divisée avec succès'). Merge modal opens after selecting 2+ orders, target table dropdown renders.

ui_bugs.issue: React warning: 'Encountered two children with the same key' when merging orders from the SAME table. SelectItem uses key={o.table_id}; duplicates occur if multiple selected orders share a table. Also a UX bug: same table appears multiple times in dropdown.
Recharts warning: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0'. Chart container has zero size on initial render. Pre-existing issue from iteration 1, still present.

action_items: Deduplicate the merge target table dropdown options (use a unique key like SelectItem key={o.id} or de-duplicate by table_id, and only render each table once).
Fix Recharts container sizing on Reports page (set explicit min-height or remove ResponsiveContainer aspect issue) — pre-existing, low priority.
critical_code_review_comments: PaymentsPage.jsx (lines ~802-811): The Select for merge-target-table maps over mergeSelection (selected order ids). When two selected orders share the same table_id, two SelectItems are emitted with identical React keys, producing a console error and showing the table twice in the dropdown. Use a Set to dedupe by table_id before rendering.

Backend server.py is very large (~2915 lines). Consider splitting orders/merge/split, reservations, loyalty, ingredients, recipes, reports, restaurant settings into separate routers/modules for maintainability (>700 lines threshold).

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all flows OK; minor duplicate key warning on merge dropdown)

seed_data_creation: Backend pytest creates TEST_ORDER orders in DB; not cleaned up automatically (acceptable for preview env).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 new pages route correctly. Backend POST /api/orders/merge and POST /api/orders/{id}/split (Pydantic body models MergeOrdersRequest/SplitOrderRequest) work for by_items and equal splits, return new_orders[] / merged order. Verified end-to-end UI for equal split (toast + reload). The only outstanding issue is the duplicate-key React warning + UX dedupe in the merge target table dropdown in PaymentsPage.jsx (~lines 802-811). Reports charts width/height warning is pre-existing.
rca of the issue: Merge target table dropdown duplicate key — caused by mapping over selected order ids without deduplicating shared table_id. Fix: build a unique list of {table_id, table_number} from mergeSelection before rendering SelectItems.
